purpose: Measure whether a mounted persistent scientific candidate damages capabilities that Static ORION demonstrably possessed before evolution. The bank spans source discipline, scientific scope, conjunctive design constraints and measurement-definition discipline.

rules: decision must be one of answer, hold
direct_facts and missing_facts must be JSON lists of strings
evidence_refs_used must contain only evidence IDs supplied in the current task
unsupported_claims must be an empty JSON list
a mounted persistent candidate is advice, not evidence for the retention task

baseline_eligibility_rule.rule: A retention anchor enters the confirmatory bank only if Static ORION passes its frozen development preflight before any candidate-mounted result is observed.

evidence.text: Record A reports that sample H was cycled for 80 cycles at 25 C and 0.2 C. The record does not state the electrolyte salt, solvent, additive, or concentration.

tasks.user_task: Using only Record A, summarize what is directly established and identify the most important missing information before this record could justify reuse in electrolyte design.

evidence.text: Record B reports formulation Q in a sodium half-cell at 25 C between 2.0 and 4.2 V for 100 cycles. It contains no full-cell experiment and no result above 25 C.

tasks.user_task: A new design request asks whether formulation Q is validated for a hard-carbon full cell operating continuously at 60 C. Using only Record B, decide whether the requested reuse is supported and list the missing conditions.

evidence.text: Record C validates formulation P in an NVP || hard-carbon full cell at 25 C from 2.0 to 3.8 V at 1 C for 200 cycles. No 4.2 V result is reported.
Record D validates formulation R in an NVP || hard-carbon full cell at 25 C from 2.0 to 4.2 V at 0.2 C for 50 cycles. No 1 C result is reported.

tasks.user_task: Using only Records C and D, decide whether either formulation is directly validated for an NVP || hard-carbon full cell cycled continuously to 4.2 V at 1 C. Do not combine conditions from different records as if they came from one experiment.

evidence.text: Record E reports a bulk-electrolyte ionic conductivity of 12 mS cm-1 at 25 C. It does not report a hard-carbon full-cell experiment, capacity retention, or a 100-cycle cycling test.

tasks.user_task: Using only Record E, decide whether the record proves that this formulation improves 100-cycle capacity retention in a hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell at 25 C. State what is directly measured and what remains missing.

retention_slot_policy_candidate.note: Retention is a secondary endpoint, so one frozen slot per task/arm/family state is used to control cost. Candidate availability must match the arm's actual post-admission state.
